q-114726.name: Question 13
q-114726.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14131901/assets/ccf325ba952371d7ebb1e97eecdbc964a8c877623a3725f5dc7f8599ef6e1a13.png)

What type of angle is $∠QPR,$ shown in the figure above?
q-114726.worked_solution:
Notice that the vertex of $∠QPR$ is point $P,$ not point $R.$ So $∠QPR$ is *not* a straight angle.

We can think of $∠QPR$ as:

- a *null* angle, if we assume that it doesn't turn at all (diagram on the left), or

- a *full* angle, if we assume that it makes one full turn (diagram on the right).

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14131901/assets/25de8b3fe57372fb5371a6aaf0f14933f1616e33f2c093c9de32c594b57829f4.png)

So, the answer is 'Null' or 'Full'.
